characters.utsuro: Male Уцуро, ancient finite corporeal spirit-like summoning being originally a human medical-ninjutsu and fūinjutsu practitioner transformed into a living spatial seal; his true personal name has not been spoken in-game.

designation.translation: Полый, опустевший, тот, внутри кого осталось место
designation.reason: The seventh ward's jailers gave him this appellation after sealing; an occupational name of the hollow carrier, NOT his given birth name, and not a claim of godhood.

public_epithets: Врач, который не выписал ни одного пациента
characters.true_nature: A historically human male survived an experimental forbidden treatment by partially converting his own living chakra circulation, memory and organs into a distributed ward-seal. He is still embodied, can be wounded and has finite chakra. His apparent spectral manifestation is space-time summoning projected through an anchored archive, not full postmortem resurrection, not a cosmic god.

scroll.long_name_ru: Свиток договора обратного призыва Седьмой палаты
scroll.name_jp: 第七病棟・逆口寄せ契約巻
scroll.old_descriptor: Договор Семи Запоров — existing player-approved commonly used nickname for the pact's SEAL STRUCTURE. It is NOT a separate pact or separate scroll.
scroll.archive_metadata: The scroll is not registered among ordinary summoning contracts. Its old gray wrap, bone clasp and forbidden entry were documented in a suppressed archive note with warning never open even to destroy; true provenance forgotten. Present known archive event has one missing genuine contract № A-117 from teaching tray, cause unresolved.
scroll.physical_origin: Originally the Seventh Ward's admissions book, written on chakra-reactive layered parchment supported by bone clasp from the facility's old surgical archives. Each new 'name' is recorded as a duty-bound medical contact rather than normal clan-summoner ownership; blood permits a signature even without informed consent (a predatory design of the seal), but does not control the signee's will.
scroll.how_arrived_in_kusa_archives: Several generations after sealing, pieces of the fallen medical sanctuary's archive entered regional shinobi bureaucracies as spoils and donated antiquities. A surviving item was misidentified as a ritual warning and stored with prohibited scrolls, later apparently placed among accessible training samples. EXACT person/time/method of placement among yellow cords and disappearance of ordinary A-117 remain UNRESOLVED in world, cannot be silently declared Utsuro's manipulation or part of V-7 affair.
scroll.activation: Tiny inadvertent blood from Shiki's hand during permitted request for summoning scrolls triggers preexisting external anchor, permanently signs reciprocal bond. This is accidental lawful contact, NOT deliberate forbidden practice, and remains irreversible by destruction of paper or regenerating skin.
scroll.signees: An ancestral bearer could call Utsuro from the ward under difficult conditions, and he could call them only once seven spatial stops and chakra requirements allowed. Original scribal column means 'дежурный у постели' / 'тот, кто откликнется на вызов', a role with terrifying implications but NOT forced service, moral duty, physical ownership or automatic combat mastery.
scroll.seven_marks: Seven incomplete concentric circles represent seven stages/doors of the medical ward sealing network, and the tangled roots represent the circuit of tissue-bound names and chakra memory. Core DARK EMPTY no human silhouette. Exact symbolic significance of each circle is a discoverable source of clues, not a set of magical weak points that simply erase the permanent bond.
scroll.known_paradox: A scroll called a summoning covenant is at once an entrance record, an emergency call-bell, and a deed to a sealed operating theater. Its opening can make normal 3D visual depth appear inverted because the true far end of the seal is physically beneath an ancient earthbound structure. The parchment has no limitless magical field, only a remote bounded aperture.

historical_origin.era: Several generations before 1283, during regional wars and disease waves before the current archive's administrative order; no hard conflict with existing campaign timeline; exact foundation and site date to be recovered, not asserted as player-known.

site.layout: Secret underground stone medical compound with seven concentric quarantine/containment wards. The so-called inverted cathedral is a real downward architectural installation of shafted pillars, suspended stone patient panels, seal conduits and a bell/taut rope. Severe optical distortion occurs only from the outside view through reversed space-time seal; the facility itself is a dangerous physical location, not infinite cosmic dimensions.
site.symbolism: Its walls are decorated with stone effigies that are in part patient records and in part organ-bound containment sarcophagi. Some retain active anchored chakra processes; whether any original patient remains alive is individually case-dependent, never general soul resurrection.

historical_origin.starting_purpose: A covert refuge treated dying war casualties and incurable disease cases with medical chakra, Yin/Yang manipulation and sealing. The principal responsible healer aimed to preserve the dying beyond the window for ordinary treatment, initially to buy time to heal.
historical_origin.transgression: To prevent losses, its medical order began anchoring patients' residual chakra-patterns and living functions outside their bodies rather than letting irreversible deaths occur. Failed revival attempts did NOT restore persons; bodies, pain responses and memory traces persisted in mutually contradictory states. Surgery became archival technology: patient morphology was edited like a seal and 'discharge' was repeatedly postponed.

two_forbidden_schools.shiton: Death side — Suiton keeps moisture and carries decomposing tissue, Doton shapes hard mineral/corpse matrices and earthen anchors, Inton retains residual cognitive/chakra contours. This makes corpse puppetry, necrosis, burial seals and unreliable echoes possible. Does NOT truly summon intact souls or instantly create endless body mass.
two_forbidden_schools.byoton: Life gone wrong — Suiton organizes the medium of living tissues, Yang forces uncontrolled growth and reflexes, Yin inscribes pathological control patterns. This corrupts regeneration into fever, abnormal growth, false repair and linked curse. These are chakra-imposed clinical catastrophes rather than literal newly engineered self-replicating germs.
two_forbidden_schools.unity: The two pseudo-nature kinjutsu schools were originally complementary treatment failures: Shiton kept a dead or dying structure from vanishing; Byoton kept an overgrown living structure from stopping. Utsuro carries both because his body became the shared control mechanism for both ward systems.

historical_origin.catastrophe: When more patients were held than the system could sustain, linked records began to overlap. Subjects saw their own bodies from outside, retained sensations without intact sensory pathways, or developed foreign motor patterns. A containment rupture threatened the surrounding district, not the world. Authorities and surviving healers sealed the entire institution with seven successive locks; subsequent generations maintained/reinforced them and revised the chronicle into a demon legend.
historical_origin.utsuro_fate: The ward's chief healer became the final living junction: surgically redirected neck chakra bundles, lungs and voice through containment seal, substituted one palmar surface with dark diagnostic slate. This ensured the bound site would retain a human decision-maker who could triage, resist escape attempts and pay costs; he was walled in with the work he had refused to let die. The seal prolonged his embodied continuity at a cost, not immortality or resurrection.
historical_origin.why_god_or_demon: Local witnesses no longer recognized patient and physician as human after seeing anatomical false limbs, joined corpses, identical sickrooms in distant perspectives and a voice across sealed walls. The terms 'demon', 'sick god' or 'spirit' are folk descriptions of an unknown former shinobi and his fūin ecology, not actual deity canon.

visual_and_medical_metaphor.gray_pale_hair: Long gray/white hair and almost ash-colored skin reflect extreme chronic long-term stasis/anatomical transformation of Utsuro, not Shiki's hair color; Shiki remains canon silver-white.
visual_and_medical_metaphor.carotid_sutures: Neck scar rows mark an old bilateral surgery establishing two seal conduits near the carotid vascular bundles, sustaining redirection of precise Yin/Yang chakra signals. They do not indicate that a normal artery was literally cut open and left bleeding for generations.
visual_and_medical_metaphor.obsidian_palm: A hand replaced/covered by dense black mineralized fūin slate functioning as diagnostic manifold. Minute pale points register active chakra-ward circuits, like many bedside vital indicators. Their dimming is loss, redistribution or isolation of a circuit; not literal death of a whole city or a small solar system.
visual_and_medical_metaphor.stone_reliefs: Stone patient panels are at once seals and records for specific incomplete treatment episodes, capable of anatomically wrong involuntary motions when a ward circuit presses against its barrier. Some may be capable of agency and mortality; don't assume all are inert or all contain living persons.
visual_and_medical_metaphor.taut_rope_and_silent_bell: An emergency call circuit crosses the wards, physically tethered to the lowest chamber. The bell may ring without a local acoustic wave via a thin bounded chakra contact, making archival sensory illusions plausible.
visual_and_medical_metaphor.hase_symptoms: A novice staring into an exposed reverse register can experience sensory viewpoint displacement, adrenergic panic, motor perseveration and nosebleed; plausible through localized Yin-mediated sensory reindexing and stress. Not a verified diagnosis or proof of teleported body in the scene until Shiki examines him.
visual_and_medical_metaphor.shiki_mark: Permanent ink-black seven rings and heavily branching roots on inner RIGHT forearm, core empty dark void. Across days/weeks Shiki becomes extremely gaunt and pale with prominent dark superficial vessels while remaining physically fast and strong; roots MAY extend to neck/chest/body at extreme effects, NEVER face. His silver-white hair and Kusagakure allegiance remain. No mandatory abnormal heat/fevers/smells/altered pain or taste. Only DIRECT bare living skin-on-skin contact can transfer anchored pathological chakra; intact clothes/gloves or ANY object barrier make touch completely safe, no indirect, airborne or object-borne disease. Nobody retroactively infected at the archive.

summoning_mechanics.bounded: Utsuro can be partially projected when ward energy reaches a specific aperture and he is willing/forced by circumstances; full manifestation requires a proper anchor, preparation, significant chakra price and compatible seal state, even if Shiki later learns hand signs. Not instant domination, teleporting entire villages, or eliminating death.
summoning_mechanics.reciprocal: Once original facilities' lock conditions are satisfied, Utsuro can request a reciprocal summoning of Shiki; it is not controlling the PC's mind, and defenses/counterplay exist against forced relocation. Initial state has insufficient energy and cannot pull Shiki against his will into depths. Contract itself has NO release mechanism.
summoning_mechanics.two_schools: Forbidden arts are separate secrets known by Utsuro and requiring real teaching, consent, practice and resources. The pact does not turn Shiki into a master of Shiton/Byoton, but its passive price activates at the original accidental binding. Utsuro's own control is finite and he can suffer depletion.
summoning_mechanics.weaknesses: Medical curse effects require target pathways, tissue/bone or seal anchors, time and chakra. Amed nin can counter patterns, barrier and non-contact attacks can resist; no limitless biohazard, no unsupported self-replicating plagues. Utsuro is autonomous and can be defeated/maimed under credible conditions; his site may fall or lose patients in consequential plots.

hidden_private_gm.true_given_name: Сайка Хисанори (才賀久典) — historical personal name of the original healer; no current NPC knows it by default, Kashiva has only Utsuro legends. Keep hidden until evidence, and user may later correct name.
hidden_private_gm.motive: He retains pride in heroic medical intention and refuses the word murder, despite signatures of consent falsified by the order. He seeks a living medical successor capable of repairing the seven wards without immediately releasing something beyond. He is not necessarily trustworthy: he might conceal that he could free some patients by abandoning the others. Moral ambiguity genuinely matters.
hidden_private_gm.former_companion: His former surgical colleague sealed in moving stone relief was once the principal co-developer of the false-regeneration branch; she has autonomous motives and some remaining embodied agency. Her name and exact state stay undisclosed until interaction, death possible; no predetermined automatic rescue.
hidden_private_gm.knowledge: Utsuro only learned Shiki's name from pact and can infer high medical role from clothing and actual behaviors; he CANNOT know Shiki's genome, V-7, school case or personal preferences without evidence.
hidden_private_gm.archive_mystery: Who placed gray scroll among yellow school samples and why A-117 vanished remains an OPEN branching investigation. Don't retroactively declare Utsuro caused it just because it fits the horror motif; if there is a culprit, show independent causal evidence.
hidden_private_gm.reveal_protocol: Kashiva can recall partial warning 'do not open, even to destroy', folkloric Utsuro, but does not know the complete seventh ward history. Hase sensory memory is unreliable while symptoms unresolved. Learn through real documents, witnesses, confrontation, tests and patient-case traces; don't give OOC design knowledge to NPCs or Shiki on next game turn.
hidden_private_gm.scene_preservation: 27Sep1283 06:33:02 archive staff consented to Shiki medical exam, he has NOT begun it. User addressed 'Мастеру' purely out of game, no passage of time, no changes to staff behavior or exam.
